California winemaker Merry Edwards is a pioneer of Russian River Valley pinot noir and other varietals. She collaborated with UC Davis Foundation Plant Services to establish the UCD-37 clonal selection – also known as the Merry Edwards Selection or Mount Eden Selections – and UCD-37 was later planted at her own estate vineyards. Over the course of her career, Edwards produced 47 vintages of pinot noir, sauvignon blanc, and other varietals in the Russian River Valley. Among other awards and recognition, she was awarded the James Beard Award for Best Wine, Beer, or Spirits; is a Culinary Institute of America’s Vintners Hall of Fame inductee; and was named American Wine Legend of the Year by Wine Enthusiast Magazine.

 This digital collection offers a small sample of the full collection, which includes photographs, wine vintage release announcements, magazines and scrapbooks, marketing collateral, and 37 binders of wine production, analysis, and tasting notes between 1997-2019.
